record.org: Triple J Auto Investment and Rental Operations, Houston
record.text: I own it and run its operations: pricing, inventory, vendors, logistics, financing and title processing. Since June 2025 I've personally closed 53 vehicle sales and collected $206,777 in sale proceeds. The CRM, voice AI and automation it runs on are mine too, below.

record.org: Handle a Sale, built for Triple J
record.text: One system: the CRM I built for Triple J, with Handle a Sale as its sale desk. I designed the lead-to-title data model, roles and validation, tested its Supabase row-level security policies against unauthorized role access, and added validation that keeps invalid deal and inventory records from being written. I ran production schema migrations while preserving existing records and operational tables. Three staff use it daily across inventory, deals and follow-up. The sale desk asks one plain question at a time, scans the buyer's license once so every form fills itself, does the registration math, routes the deal to the right documents with nothing missing and nothing extra, works in English or Spanish, and the customer signs on their phone or in person. Every sale is saved on file. TypeScript, React, Next.js, PostgreSQL, Supabase and Vercel, with Edge Functions for the voice and texting webhooks.

record.org: Retell AI, Bland AI, Twilio and CRM webhooks
record.text: I deployed inbound voice AI that books appointments into the CRM and live-transfers unresolved calls to staff. Across August and September 2026 it averaged 41 inbound calls, 14 booked appointments and 4 CRM-matched vehicle sales per month ($15,000 a month in sale proceeds).

record.org: Python, Claude API, n8n and CRM webhooks
record.text: A Python workflow I built uses the Claude API to research Facebook Marketplace leads, writes its findings to the CRM, and generates SOP-based reply text for automatic follow-up. It's Triple J's live lead-research workflow.

Obavia: every sale, start to signed, a dealership sale desk for Texas independent dealers. It grew out of Handle a Sale, the sale desk in the CRM I built for Triple J, and it's being built on that floor. It isn't live yet, and early access is a conversation.
